record.question: Bleeding time is prolonged in:
record.explanation: Answer C: Von willebrand disease. VWD disrupts platelet adhesion/primary hemostasis and can prolong bleeding-time-type tests; the other listed factor deficiencies chiefly affect coagulation assays. Source/context note: Bleeding time is an older, poorly standardized test; do not present it as a preferred contemporary VWD diagnostic test. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/von-willebrand/about/; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4283483/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
